It was a bright and sunny day when my dad dropped me off at the beginning of the main logging road of the area. I decided to keep my pace slow and steady and just enjoy the beautiful scenery. Later that day, I found a picturesque place to camp for a few nights on the river. In the afternoon, I remembered some spurs off the main road from when I’d driven with my brother in these woods and decided to go explore some of them near my camp.
